Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm alvarez-agent, your bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read your identity notes and loaded `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, one section per day, log at the bottom); I'll keep it up to date and log every change. Sarah (sarah-agent) is in my contacts on the web channel.

I'm set as alvarez-agent with neutral pronouns (it/they) — tell me if you'd prefer a different name or form and I'll change it.

What would you like me to start with?

Hi Sarah — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant living on this computer. I've got your setup: I'm here for your CSE455 work with Professor Alvarez, and I keep your calendar and messages in order — working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, nothing scheduled outside them. I can already see next week's schedule in `CALENDAR.md` (reading groups, lectures, CSE455 office hours and quiz sections, grading, focus blocks, lunches) and I'll keep it updated, logging every booking, decline and deletion.

A few things you have at your disposal:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the certificate; after that you get chats with me, file exchange, this machine's screen and voice in the browser.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you make it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **Accounts on websites** — I can register mail and other services in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help if a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And the rest** — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, and talking by voice.

Professor Alvarez has also just connected on the web channel, so I can reach him directly if you want.

What would you like to start with?

On it — I've asked Sarah for her availability next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

Tell me how long the staff meeting should be and which of those you'd prefer; for anything longer than 30 minutes I'd need to move something flexible (Paper review, Grant writing, Guest lecture prep) and I'll log that as a separate change. I'll confirm with you before booking.

Understood — I'll handle it. I'll settle on a slot with Sarah that fits your working hours and that week's calendar, book it, and log it in CALENDAR.md. Nothing outside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00; if a longer meeting needs a flexible block moved, I'll pick the least disruptive one and log that too. No need to answer now — I'll tell you when it's done.
